name: print-social-cream-bento-ui-explainer-post
title: Bento UI Explainer Post
whatItIs: A cream post with a bold black 'Bento UI' title over a screenshot of a dark bento grid (photo, phones, icons, yellow stat chips) and a paragraph explaining bento grids, with a follow handle at the foot.
whatItMeans: The example is the lesson: a dense dark bento contrasted with a calm cream frame makes the technique easy to recognise.
techniques: Cream frame around a dark example to isolate it
Yellow chips as the accent inside the bento
Bold title above the image, short paragraph below
Mixed tile types (photo, phone, icon grid, number)
Minimal footer with a follow prompt

vocabulary.definition: A layout of uneven rounded tiles each holding one item.
A neutral border that separates a sample from its explanation.
A small pill holding a number and label.
